source: Toprank Review Academy (TRA) Nursing Module – Complete Handout

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A kidney transplant client on cyclosporine should be monitored for:
questions.rationale: Cyclosporine causes nephrotoxicity, hypertension, tremor, hirsutism, and infection risk.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A client on cyclosporine is distressed by increased body hair. The nurse explains:
questions.rationale: Hirsutism is reversible after treatment ends; never stop abruptly.
questions.quote: Hirsutism is reversible when the treatment stops

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A client on acyclovir should be taught to:
questions.rationale: Antivirals can be nephrotoxic; increase fluids and complete therapy.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which antiviral is used for influenza?
questions.rationale: Oseltamivir treats influenza; acyclovir treats herpes.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: When infusing IV amphotericin B, the nurse should:
questions.rationale: Use an infusion device, protect from light, and monitor renal function and blood work.
questions.quote: Use infusion device for IV administration

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Which adverse effect is common during amphotericin B therapy?
questions.rationale: Antifungals cause fever, chills, GI upset, headache, and renal impairment.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A client taking griseofulvin for ringworm should be told to:
questions.quote: Instruct the client to avoid sunlight

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Individuals: Communicable & Non-Communicable Diseases
questions.stem: Which drug is an anthelminthic used in school deworming?
questions.rationale: Albendazole and mebendazole treat intestinal worms.

questions.subject: NP I
questions.topic: Care of Individuals: Communicable & Non-Communicable Diseases
questions.stem: A client on long-term antimalarials needs regular:
questions.rationale: Antimalarials can cause visual disturbances; give with food.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: Ceftriaxone belongs to which cephalosporin generation?
questions.rationale: Third generation includes ceftriaxone, cefotaxime, ceftazidime; cefepime is fourth.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: An aminoglycoside may potentiate which agent during surgery?
questions.rationale: Aminoglycosides potentiate neuromuscular blockade and anesthesia.
